index.title: {{BRAND}} — Vedic Astrology from Bṛhat Parāśara Horā Śāstra
index.sub: {{BRAND}} — {{GLOSS}} — is a source-grounded curriculum for Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, from first principles to chart synthesis.
index.desc: A source-grounded Vedic astrology curriculum built on Bṛhat Parāśara Horā Śāstra, with a free chart engine that computes Ṣaḍbala, Aṣṭakavarga and sixteen divisional charts in your browser.

grahas.title: The Nine Grahas — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
grahas.sub: Full profiles of the Sun through Ketu, the natural benefics and malefics, and the working classifications.
grahas.desc: The nine grahas of Vedic astrology — their natural significations, benefic and malefic character, dignities and karakatvas, as Bṛhat Parāśara Horā Śāstra describes them.

dignity.title: Planetary Dignity & Relationships — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
dignity.sub: Exaltation, debilitation, Moolatrikona and own sign; the three tiers of friendship; combustion, war and retrogression; and the nodes.
dignity.desc: Exaltation, debilitation, moolatrikona, own sign and the friendship tables — how a graha's strength is graded by the sign it stands in, with the BPHS rules set out in full.

rashis.title: The Twelve Rashis — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
rashis.sub: Every sign profiled, plus the modality, element, parity, rising-type, fertility and Kalapurusha classifications that drive later technique.
rashis.desc: The twelve rāśis: element, mode, gender, lord, body part and the classical descriptions from Bṛhat Parāśara Horā Śāstra, with how each shapes a graha placed in it.

bhavas.title: The Twelve Bhavas — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
bhavas.sub: House significations and karakas in depth, functional classes, bhava-lord placements with a worked case, house strength, and how a house prospers or breaks.
bhavas.desc: The twelve bhāvas and what each governs, with the BPHS significations, the bhāva lord's role, and how kendra, trikona, dusthāna and upachaya classify them.

lagna.title: Lagna & Special Ascendants — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
lagna.sub: The rising point that anchors the chart, the twelve ascendant temperaments, and the computed Bhava, Hora, Ghatika, Arudha, Sree and Prana ascendants.
lagna.desc: The lagna — the point of the ecliptic rising in the east — how it is computed, why it moves a degree every four minutes, and why rāśis take unequal times to rise.

vargas.title: Shodasha Vargas — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
vargas.sub: All sixteen divisional charts, how to read a varga, and the significance of each of the twelve houses within every chart that is read as a chart.
vargas.desc: The sixteen divisional charts of BPHS — Horā, Drekkāṇa, Navāṃśa, Daśāṃśa and the rest — how each is computed and what each refines in the rāśi chart.

aspects.title: Aspects — Graha & Rashi Drishti — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
aspects.sub: Planetary aspects with the graded glances and Virupa values, sign aspects in full, aspects on houses, and when to use which system.
aspects.desc: Graha dṛṣṭi and rāśi dṛṣṭi: the seventh-house aspect every graha casts, the special aspects of Maṅgala, Guru and Śani, and how the two aspect systems differ.

strength.title: Strength — Shadbala, Bhava Bala & Ishta/Kashta — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
strength.sub: Every Shadbala component and its sub-parts and minimums, house strength, benefic vs difficult potency, and Vimsopaka divisional strength.
strength.desc: Ṣaḍbala in full: sthāna, dig, kāla, cheṣṭā, naisargika and dṛk bala, with Iṣṭa and Kaṣṭa, Viṃśopaka and the required rūpa thresholds, worked step by step.

special-points.title: Arudhas, Argala, Karakas & Karakamsa — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
special-points.sub: Image-points and how to read the Arudha Lagna and Upapada, interventions, both karaka schemes, and the Karakamsa lagna.
special-points.desc: Arudha padas, Upapada, Argala, the Chara Karakas and Karakāṃśa — the special points of BPHS and Jaimini-adjacent technique, with how each is derived.

yogas.title: Yogas — the full catalogue — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
yogas.sub: Yogakaraka, the five Mahapurusha yogas, lunar and solar yogas, the 32 Nabhasa yogas, Raja and Dhana yogas, Parivartana, Vipareeta and Neechabhanga, and the arishta and penury combinations.
yogas.desc: Rāja yogas, Dhana yogas, the Nābhasa yogas and the lunar and solar combinations of BPHS — formation, classical effect, and the cancellation and timing that decide them.

avasthas-longevity.title: Avasthas, Longevity & Maraka — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
avasthas-longevity.sub: The five avastha schemes, and the longevity methods and Maraka doctrine — presented academically, with care.
avasthas-longevity.desc: Bālādi and the other avasthās, with the BPHS longevity and māraka chapters treated as historical doctrine rather than prediction.

dashas.title: Dashas — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
dashas.sub: Vimshottari with worked balance-at-birth and sub-period examples, the conditional nakshatra dashas, and the rasi (sign) dashas of BPHS.
dashas.desc: Viṃśottarī daśā from first principles — the nakṣatra lords, the 120-year cycle, balance at birth, and antardaśā arithmetic, with the other BPHS daśā systems.

ashtakavarga.title: Ashtakavarga — {{BRAND}} (BPHS)
ashtakavarga.sub: Benefic-point rules, Bhinna- and Sarvashtakavarga with reading thresholds, kakshas, the three shodhanas, and transit interpretation.
ashtakavarga.desc: Aṣṭakavarga worked in full: the bindus each graha contributes, Trikoṇa and Ekādhipatya śodhana, and Sarvāṣṭakavarga with the 337 total that must hold.

now.title: Hindu time now — the pañcāṅga for this moment — {{BRAND}}
now.sub: The five limbs of the day as they stand, for the place you choose — computed in your browser, with no birth chart needed.
now.desc: The current Hindu date and time for any place: tithi, nakṣatra, yoga, karaṇa and vāra with their end-times, the lunar month in both reckonings, sunrise and sunset, and the later-tradition divisions of the day.

calendar.title: Pañcāṅga calendar — any month, 1800–2200 — {{BRAND}}
calendar.desc: A full Hindu calendar for any month between 1800 and 2200, computed in your browser for the place you choose: month grid with moon phases, the traditional almanac row, a day detail showing the rule behind every festival, and a year view that shows intercalary months.
calendar.sub: Any month from 1800 to 2200, for the place you choose — with the rule behind every festival shown beside it.

studio.title: Studio — what to post today — {{BRAND}}
studio.desc: Given a date and a place, what is actually happening in the sky that is worth posting about — with the caption and the image, every figure computed in your browser rather than looked up.
studio.sub: What is worth posting today — the caption, the numbers behind it, and the image.

studio-pro.title: Studio Pro — the combinatorial animation workstation — {{BRAND}}
studio-pro.desc: Every quantity the engines compute, published as a shape, and a set of composers that draw any combination of them. Pick one node or eight; the stage finds a way to draw them, and says what it could not use.
studio-pro.sub: Every calculation as a clickable node. Combine any of them; the stage composes the animation.

reel.title: Reel Studio — stories a computation tells — {{BRAND}}
reel.desc: Build vertical reels from real computation: every new Moon and how far it stood from the node, a thread drawn between two planets for centuries, every hiding of a graha in the Sun's glare. Rendered as light, recorded in your browser, sent nowhere.
reel.sub: A question, the computation that answers it, and the figure it draws.

director-pro.title: Director Pro — the keyframe reel workstation — {{BRAND}}
director-pro.desc: A keyframe animation workstation for Vedic-astronomy reels. Scenes, layers, keyframes on every property, effects, masks, blend modes, a camera, transitions, a soundtrack from your own machine, and frame-accurate export up to 4K — all of it in the browser, with nothing uploaded.
director-pro.sub: Scenes, layers and a keyframe on every property. The same composers, none of the decisions, and an export that posts without conversion.

siddhanta.title: Sūrya Siddhānta — the older sky, computed — {{BRAND}}
siddhanta.desc: A working Sūrya Siddhānta engine: ahargaṇa, yuga revolutions, manda and śīghra epicycles, true longitudes — set beside a modern ephemeris, with the drift between them drawn.
siddhanta.sub: The same sky, computed the older way — the two set side by side, the epicycles drawn, and the text's own constants open to correction.

engine-lab.title: Engine lab — three engines, one question — {{BRAND}}
engine-lab.sub: The modern ephemeris, the Sūrya Siddhānta and its fitted tier put to the same questions — and what their disagreements are actually worth.
engine-lab.desc: Every engine in the project asked the same question at once — where the grahas are, which nakṣatra, which tithi, which daśā — with the agreement rate measured over any span, a converter that turns arcseconds into fractions of a division and days of Viṃśottarī, and one logarithmic ruler showing that the conventions disagree by degrees where the engines disagree by arcminutes.

simulation.title: Simulation — what if the Moon moved? — {{BRAND}}
simulation.desc: A gravitational simulator for counterfactuals: move the Moon an inch, stop it revolving, double its mass, take it away — and integrate the equations of motion to find out what follows, for the sky and for the system this site teaches.
simulation.sub: Change one thing about the Earth, the Moon or the Sun, and integrate the consequences.

404.title: Page not found — {{BRAND}}
404.desc: That address is not on this site. Links to the chart builder, the pañcāṅga for now, and the main reference pages.
404.sub: That address is not on this site — here is where the links usually point.

accuracy.title: Accuracy & Precision — what the engines are measured to — {{BRAND}}
accuracy.sub: What the engines are measured to, against an independent computation of the sky — and the far larger differences that are convention rather than error.
accuracy.desc: Measured accuracy of the Nirayana chart engines: per-graha residuals against ERFA over 1800–2200, what they cost each varga, nakṣatra and daśā boundary, the 5.83° spread across seventeen ayanāṃśa conventions, and the Sūrya Siddhānta tiers.

ecliptic.title: Ecliptic wheel — the sky animated through a span — {{BRAND}}
ecliptic.sub: The rāśis, nakṣatras and the nine grahas at their true longitudes, for any moment and place, played through a span you choose — no birth chart needed.
ecliptic.desc: The animated sidereal ecliptic wheel for any moment and place: the twelve rāśis and twenty-seven nakṣatras with each graha at its true longitude, played through a span from six hours to thirty years, with trails that make a retrograde loop visible, graha dṛṣṭi as chords, a settable tilt, and any of the sixteen vargas.

divisions.title: Divisions of the circle — rāśi, nakṣatra, pāda — {{BRAND}}
divisions.sub: Twelve rāśis, twenty-seven nakṣatras and a hundred and eight pādas drawn on one wheel — and why a pāda and a navāṃśa are the same thing.
divisions.desc: The three nested divisions of the zodiac on one interactive wheel: twelve rāśis, twenty-seven nakṣatras and a hundred and eight pādas, with the elemental, modal and parity classifications as colour overlays, the nine Viṃśottarī lords shown repeating three times, and the identity between a pāda and a navāṃśa derived rather than asserted.

graha-lab.title: Graha lab — dignity as a map — {{BRAND}}
graha-lab.sub: Every graha's dignity across the whole zodiac in one picture, with the nine described one by one and their real speeds measured — no birth chart required.
graha-lab.desc: The dignity scheme drawn rather than tabulated: each graha's exaltation, debilitation, own signs, mūlatrikoṇa band and friendships across all 360°, with the nine grahas' natural character, live positions and conditions for any moment and place, their daily motion on one logarithmic scale, and why Rāhu and Ketu stand outside the scheme.

bhava-systems.title: Bhāva systems — where a house begins — {{BRAND}}
bhava-systems.sub: Whole sign, equal and Śrīpati drawn on one circle for any moment and place — and exactly which grahas they disagree about.
bhava-systems.desc: The three ways of dividing the twelve bhāvas compared on one wheel for any moment and place: whole sign, equal from the lagna, and the Śrīpati construction from the lagna and the MC, with the grahas each system places differently, the fifteen-degree madhya rule drawn, and how far latitude distorts the houses.

ayanamsa.title: Ayanāṃśa — the gap between two zodiacs — {{BRAND}}
ayanamsa.sub: Two zodiacs, two different zeros, and the angle between them — explained from scratch, measured live, and open to one you invent yourself.
ayanamsa.desc: What the ayanāṃśa is and why it exists, with the gap between the sidereal and tropical zeros drawn for any year, the formula shown term by term, a measured account of what it changes and what it mathematically cannot, all nineteen definitions compared, the band the evidence actually allows, and a sandbox for building your own.

starwheel.title: Star wheel — the whole sky for any day — {{BRAND}}
starwheel.sub: The whole sky as a tilted disc for any day and place, with that day’s pañcāṅga beneath it — no birth chart needed.
starwheel.desc: The tilted star wheel for any day and place, with the twenty-seven yogatārās at their own longitude and latitude, the whole day’s tithi, nakṣatra, yoga and karaṇa with their end-times, kṣaya and adhika tithis named, and a customisable card to share.

credits.title: Credits & licences — {{BRAND}}
credits.sub: Whose work this site is built with, what each piece does, and the terms it comes under.
credits.desc: The third-party components and texts behind {{BRAND}}: astronomy-engine (MIT), GeoNames place data (CC BY 4.0), the HYG star database (CC BY-SA 4.0), Apache ECharts and ZRender, and the translations cited.
